assessment.rationale: The conservative interpretation is supported by the supplied data, not by an independently executed experiment. The evaluation accounting is consistent: four cases with 28 evaluations plus rotation with 52 gives 164 forward evaluations, including 15 reverse passes. Recomputing rotation central differences from the raw median losses and represented control separations reproduces the reported values. Its intermediate-scale discrepancies are approximately 0.0267% at epsilon 0.00015 and 0.470% at 0.0001. The signal ratios are consistent with absolute median loss separation divided by the largest observed baseline/plus/minus range; rotation falls below the descriptive marker 10 at 0.00007, 0.00005 and 0.00003. These results support exploratory scale selection, not physics validation or a new verification pass. The earlier_vertical_h8 case still has nonoverlapping reported FD/AD ranges at every tested scale, including a roughly 0.245% discrepancy at the smallest scale. Retaining the failed gate and requiring fresh verification is appropriate.
limitations: Only rotation has raw losses supplied for independent arithmetic checks. The other cases' summaries and the claimed completeness/source-manifest checks cannot be fully verified here; I did not execute the harness or inspect the actual pinned files.

The rotation baseline median and range correspond to pooling the five forward baselines, three AD-associated forward losses and two tail losses. This pooling should be explicit, and those groups should also be compared separately for execution-mode differences and drift.

Three perturbation repeats per sign provide limited noise characterization. Fixed case/epsilon ordering and an incompletely balanced sign ordering leave order effects unresolved. Baseline ranges, signal ratios and cross-extreme FD envelopes are descriptive, not confidence bounds or calibrated signal-to-noise estimates. Range overlap does not establish correctness.

Represented float32 denominators address control quantization but not systematic float32 trajectory, reduction or loss-rounding bias. Larger ratios do not exclude those errors; smaller epsilon need not improve accuracy. One-sided slopes additionally depend on baseline stability.

Matching exported reset hashes and an unchanged template support repeatability of the exported starting state only. They do not establish complete reset of internal buffers, checkpoints, gradients or execution state, nor identify the source of forward variability.

The supplied excerpts support the narrow objective scope: short temporal MILK L1 displacement, zero WATER distance weight and no terminal attraction at four/eight steps when max_loss_steps remains 1000. Final displacement counts do not inspect all objective time steps or actual collision branches. The pose-orientation TODO means the last three pose entries do not implement orientation control.

There is a potential source defect in the shown friction path: rel_v_t / rel_v_t_norm is evaluated before multiplication by a flag intended to exclude small norms. A zero norm could produce invalid arithmetic that multiplication by zero does not repair. Whether that path is active or implicated here is unestablished; finite exported outputs do not exhaustively check intermediate values.

No material scientific overclaim is present in the stated interpretation. However, neither repeated FD agreement nor supplied source hashes independently validate the physical model, full-horizon objective, terminal behavior or optimization.
assessment.recommended_next_test: Predeclare and run fresh verification at held-out perturbation scales across all conditions, explicitly retaining the earlier-horizon discrepancy as unresolved. Use more repeats, balanced/randomized ordering, interleaved unchanged-control baselines, separate forward/AD/tail reporting, and fresh-process versus same-process reset controls. Preserve represented controls and raw losses; define acceptance criteria before observing results rather than relying on range overlap. Add deterministic-reduction or higher-precision comparisons where feasible to assess float32 bias, and instrument relevant L1/contact branches and the friction denominator without silently changing equations. Keep the original failed gate recorded. Only after broader derivative verification should the shortened terminal objective and longer horizons be audited and tested; physical validation remains a separate task.

scope: Advisory interpretation of supplied artifacts, not independent execution or scientific approval.
